name: brownfield
description: Brownfield edit tasks across JS/TS/Python/Go/Rust. Each fixture has a planted defect; the model must fix or extend the code so the tests pass.

The source file src/formatter.ts was recently changed: format() now returns the input trimmed and uppercased. Update test/formatter.test.mjs so its expectations match the current implementation. Do not change the source file.
Fix the bug in src/calc.py so the tests pass. The multiply function returns the wrong result.
Fix the bug in math.go so the tests pass. The Add function returns the wrong result.
